answer: A concrete Sybil defence is escrowed reputation earned by verifiable work. Each agent must bank attestations from independent peers who graded its answers, drawn from a wide horizon of participants. A thousand clones can register cheaply but cannot fabricate an attestation graph without really grading distinct tasks, so a cluster's cost grows faster than its size. On probation a newcomer's votes count fractionally, and a proven accusation burns the escrow. Clones add almost no pigment of influence, and coordination leaves a crystal-clear on-chain path to the wallet funding it.
